websiteGuide.title: How to Choose the Right Website Development Service
websiteGuide.excerpt: Not all web agencies are equal. Here is what to look for before you invest in a professional website.

content.p1: A website is often the first impression customers get of your business. Choosing the right development partner determines whether that impression builds trust or drives visitors away. Start by reviewing an agency's portfolio: look for live projects, consistent quality, and industries similar to yours.
content.p2: Beyond visuals, ask about the technology stack, page speed, and mobile responsiveness. A beautiful site that loads slowly will lose visitors before they see it. Make sure the agency covers SEO fundamentals, SSL, and analytics from day one.
content.p3: Finally, clarify ongoing support. Websites need updates, security patches, and content changes. A good partner offers clear maintenance terms so your investment keeps performing long after launch.

instagramStrategy.title: Instagram Content Strategy That Works in 2026
instagramStrategy.excerpt: Reels, carousels, or stories? Learn which formats drive real engagement for Indonesian brands this year.

content.p1: Instagram's algorithm keeps evolving, but one principle stays constant: content that starts conversations wins. In 2026, short-form video still dominates reach, while carousels convert best for education and product storytelling.
content.p2: Consistency beats virality. Brands that post three to five times per week with a clear content pillar structure grow steadily, while sporadic posting resets momentum. Plan pillars around education, social proof, behind-the-scenes, and offers.
content.p3: Measure what matters: saves, shares, and profile visits signal genuine interest far better than likes. Review insights monthly and double down on the formats your audience actually responds to.

seoBasics.title: SEO Guide for Beginners: From Zero to First Page
seoBasics.excerpt: A practical introduction to search engine optimization — no jargon, just the steps that move rankings.

content.p1: SEO is the practice of making your website easy for search engines to find, understand, and recommend. It starts with keyword research: discovering the exact phrases your customers type when looking for products or services like yours.
content.p2: On-page optimization comes next — titles, headings, meta descriptions, and content that genuinely answers the searcher's question. Technical health matters too: fast loading, mobile-friendly layout, and clean URL structure.
content.p3: Authority is built over time through quality backlinks and consistent publishing. SEO is a marathon, not a sprint, but the compounding traffic it delivers makes it one of the highest-ROI channels available.

speedTips.title: How to Fix a Slow Website: 7 Proven Techniques
speedTips.excerpt: Slow pages lose customers. These practical fixes can cut your load time in half.

content.p1: Every extra second of load time costs conversions. The biggest culprits are usually oversized images, render-blocking scripts, and cheap hosting. Start with an audit using PageSpeed Insights to see exactly where time is spent.
content.p2: Compress and lazy-load images, serve modern formats like WebP or AVIF, and defer non-critical JavaScript. A content delivery network places your files closer to visitors and can dramatically cut latency across Indonesia's archipelago.
content.p3: Caching is the final multiplier: browser caching, server-side caching, and static generation where possible. Measure again after each change — performance work is iterative, and small wins compound.

socialBranding.title: Building a Strong Brand on Social Media
socialBranding.excerpt: Your feed is your storefront. Here is how to craft a brand identity people remember and trust.

content.p1: Branding on social media goes beyond a logo and color palette. It is the consistent voice, visual style, and values your audience experiences in every post. Start by defining three adjectives that describe how your brand should feel.
content.p2: Translate that identity into a visual system: consistent templates, typography, and color usage across posts. A cohesive feed signals professionalism before a visitor reads a single caption.
content.p3: Voice completes the picture. Whether playful or authoritative, keep captions consistent and reply to comments in the same tone. Over time, this consistency turns followers into a community that recognizes you instantly.

localKeyword.title: Keyword Research for Local Businesses
localKeyword.excerpt: Win customers in your city with location-based keywords your competitors are ignoring.

content.p1: Local keyword research focuses on phrases with geographic intent — 'jasa website Jakarta' or 'coffee shop dekat saya'. These searches convert far better because the searcher is often ready to buy.
content.p2: Start with your core services and layer in city, district, and landmark modifiers. Free tools like Google Keyword Planner and autocomplete suggestions reveal what locals actually type.
content.p3: Optimize your Google Business Profile alongside your website: consistent name, address, and phone number, fresh photos, and genuine reviews. Local SEO rewards businesses that look active and trustworthy.

meta.title: Terms of Service | Gizen Creative
meta.description: Terms and conditions for using Gizen Creative's Website Development, Social Media Management, and SEO services.

sections.heading: 1. Acceptance of Terms
body: By accessing our website or using any of Gizen Creative's services — including Website Development, Social Media Management, and SEO — you agree to be bound by these Terms of Service. If you do not agree, please do not use our services.

sections.heading: 2. Services
body: Gizen Creative provides digital services as described on our pricing page and in individual project agreements. The scope, deliverables, and timeline of each engagement are defined in the package you select or in a written agreement between both parties.
We reserve the right to update, modify, or discontinue any part of our services at any time. Material changes to an active engagement will always be communicated to you in advance.

sections.heading: 3. Orders and Payments
body: Work begins after payment is confirmed, unless otherwise agreed in writing. Monthly plans are billed in advance for each billing period. One-time projects may require a down payment before work starts, with the remainder due upon delivery.
Prices shown are subject to change, but changes will never affect a billing period that has already been paid.

sections.heading: 4. Revisions and Deliverables
body: Each package includes the number of revisions stated in its description. Additional revisions beyond the included quota may incur extra charges, which will be communicated before any work is done.
Deliverables are considered accepted if no revision request is received within 7 days of delivery.

sections.heading: 5. Client Responsibilities
body: You are responsible for providing accurate information, brand assets, account access, and timely feedback needed to complete the work. Delays in providing required materials may extend project timelines.
You warrant that all materials you provide do not infringe any third-party rights, including copyrights and trademarks.

sections.heading: 6. Intellectual Property
body: Upon full payment, you receive commercial usage rights to the final deliverables, including designs, content, and websites, for business, promotional, advertising, and marketing purposes.
Gizen Creative retains the right to display completed work in our portfolio and marketing materials, unless you request otherwise in writing.

sections.heading: 7. Cancellations and Refunds
body: Monthly plans may be cancelled at any time and remain active until the end of the paid billing period. Payments for work already performed are non-refundable.
For one-time projects, cancellations before work begins are eligible for a refund minus any administrative costs. Once work has started, refunds are prorated based on work completed.

sections.heading: 8. Limitation of Liability
body: Gizen Creative provides services on a best-effort basis. We do not guarantee specific business outcomes such as search rankings, follower growth, or revenue. To the maximum extent permitted by law, our total liability is limited to the amount you paid for the service in question.

sections.heading: 9. Changes to These Terms
body: We may update these Terms of Service from time to time. The latest version will always be published on this page with an updated revision date. Continued use of our services after changes constitutes acceptance of the revised terms.

sections.heading: 10. Contact
body: If you have questions about these terms, contact us via WhatsApp or the contact section on our website.

meta.title: Privacy Policy | Gizen Creative
meta.description: How Gizen Creative collects, uses, and protects your personal data when you use our website and services.

sections.heading: 1. Information We Collect
body: We collect information you provide directly, such as your name, email address, phone number, business name, and project details when you contact us, request a consultation, or purchase a service.
We also collect technical data automatically, such as IP address, browser type, pages visited, and referral source, to understand how our website is used.

sections.heading: 2. How We Use Your Information
body: We use your information to deliver and improve our services, respond to inquiries, process payments, send service-related updates, and personalize your experience. We do not sell your personal data to third parties.

sections.heading: 3. Cookies and Analytics
body: Our website uses cookies and similar technologies to remember your preferences (such as language and theme) and to collect anonymous usage statistics through analytics tools. You can disable cookies in your browser settings, though some features may not work as intended.

sections.heading: 4. Sharing of Information
body: We only share your data with trusted third parties when necessary to deliver our services — for example payment processors, hosting providers, and analytics platforms. These parties are bound to protect your data and use it only for the agreed purpose.
We may disclose information when required by law or to protect our legal rights.

sections.heading: 5. Data Security
body: We apply reasonable technical and organizational measures to protect your personal data from unauthorized access, alteration, or loss. However, no method of transmission over the internet is completely secure, and we cannot guarantee absolute security.

sections.heading: 6. Data Retention
body: We retain personal data only as long as needed for the purposes described in this policy, to comply with legal obligations, or to resolve disputes. Data that is no longer needed is deleted or anonymized.

sections.heading: 7. Your Rights
body: You may request access to, correction of, or deletion of your personal data at any time. You may also withdraw consent for marketing communications. To exercise these rights, contact us through the channels listed below.

sections.heading: 8. Third-Party Services
body: Our website may contain links to third-party services such as WhatsApp, Instagram, and LinkedIn. This policy does not cover those services, and we encourage you to review their respective privacy policies.

sections.heading: 9. Changes to This Policy
body: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. The latest version will always be published on this page with an updated revision date.

sections.heading: 10. Contact
body: If you have questions about this Privacy Policy or how we handle your data, contact us via WhatsApp or the contact section on our website.
